rapport_notes: Friendly and helpful with packing details, but several audio/connection issues ('you just cut out,' 'Mm-hmm' backchanneling) undercut professionalism; tone remains conversational but not consistently warm.
process_discipline_notes: No evidence of repeating differentiators; silence after open-ended questions was not meaningfully held, but no explicit violations of the process rules scored.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Rep never asked 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move, and what do you want answers to on this call?' — customer's damage concern was volunteered unprompted.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised damage concern ('there was a few damages and I just wanna move with a company that has like a better policy than them'). Rep answered with the no-worries policy but did not ask follow-up probes like 'tell me more about what happened' or 'what else is on your list of concerns' — moved straight to explaining the coverage.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Rep never delivered any of the five Save Your Ass lines. No mention of '100k moves' / experience framing, no 'estimate is a window because your move is yours,' no 'if the crew beats it you pay less,' no self-prep tip, and no 'does that feel fair?' followed by silence. Estimate was 'probably under $800 for your move for sure' — a range, but no window-framing or silence hold afterward.

top_strength: Calvin identified and directly addressed the customer's primary pain point (prior damage coverage experience) with a clear, credible explanation of Einstein's no-worries coverage ($2,000 per move, repair/replacement process) — this landed well and reassured the customer.
coaching_note: Ask the agenda question ('Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?') **before** launching into logistics probing, then use two-layer follow-up on every concern raised; also completely skip Stage 2 and Stage 3 frameworks — deliver On-Time Guarantee, Communication (day-before call, named crew lead), Save Your Ass (100k moves, estimate window, beats-it-pay-less, self-prep tip), and close rate-lock + explicit ask.
